note: A general-audience explainer of Levent Alpöge's claimed proof with Claude, released as Lean code with a four-page outline. Abhishek Saha (Queen Mary) argues the credit belongs to Alpöge rather than the AI, and Kevin Buzzard (Imperial) says nobody yet understands what the proof shows.
title: Riemann hypothesis: Has the world’s most famous maths problem been cracked?
